provenance: TFG (Ye et al. 2024) release; not trained by us
caveats: Sampler is OUR probability-flow ODE, not EDM's 1000-step ancestral SDE. A shortfall against the published row is not by itself an adapter defect.
novelty_vs_train_a is computed against OUR half of QM9. This model's own training half is unknown, so its novelty numbers measure nothing about it and must not be quoted.
Molecule sizes are drawn from train_a, the same histogram our own benchmark uses, so the two runs are paired. Total variation between the halves' size histograms is 0.0064.

QM9 preprocessing is ours (133,885 molecules, private random split), not the published protocol. Same caveat as BASE_MODEL_BENCHMARK.md Section 2, and it applies to both rows equally here, which is the point.
